title: GoHighLevel (GHL) Automation & CRM Specialist

description_text: Condensed from the public post. Configure and optimize the agency GoHighLevel account, create client subaccounts, build standard pipelines and stages, lead tracking, and custom fields. Configure calendars, scheduling, and reminders; build reusable templates and snapshots for client onboarding. Build email and SMS follow-up sequences, lead notifications, lead assignment, missed-call text-back, and reactivation workflows; troubleshoot errors and improve deliverability. Build GHL landing pages and funnels, connect forms, calendars, and CRM workflows, integrate Meta lead forms and Google Ads conversion tracking. Integrate third-party systems via native integrations, webhooks, n8n, or Zapier and test every lead journey from form submission to booking. Build onboarding workflows, client reporting dashboards, and SOPs. Healthcare brand: new patient inquiry funnels, intake scheduling, clinic calendar integrations, appointment reporting, following HIPAA, patient privacy, and consent rules. Required: professional GHL experience; workflows, triggers, pipelines, calendars, forms, funnels, snapshots; email and SMS automation; Meta and Google lead form integrations; independent troubleshooting; webhooks and APIs; clear English documentation. Preferred: agency multi-subaccount experience, AI chat/voice/appointment-booking automation, n8n/Zapier/Make, Stripe, healthcare or med spa practices, A2P 10DLC.
